title: hieracium murorum subsp. lyratifolium
intro: Hieracium murorum subsp. lyratifolium, commonly known as Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family that grows in mountainous regions. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium murorum subsp. lyratifolium include promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects, which may help to protect against infections and autoimmune disorders. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
